notes.title: Patch Note 1.8
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, Researchers![/h1]

[h2][b]We've released version 1.8, bringing several fixes and improvements:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed numerous bugs, including soft locks.
[*] Simplified the parkour location for a smoother experience.
[*] Added 2 new locations to explore.
[*] Optimized several levels for better performance.
[/list]

Note: The first anomaly level still has performance issues. We're actively working on a solution.

Thank you for your support!

tags.bug: [*] Fixed numerous bugs, including soft locks.
